title: Progress, XP & Badges
summary: Learn how to level up, earn badges, and track your progress in Monster Lab.

steps.title: Earning XP
steps.markdownContent:
As you complete lessons, quizzes, and challenges, you earn **XP** (Experience Points).

XP is a measure of your robotics knowledge. The more you learn, the more XP you get!

quickCheck.question: How do you earn Experience Points (XP) and unlock new badges in Monster Lab?
options: By completing lessons, building circuits, and passing challenge checkpoints
quickCheck.explanation: Completing learning journeys and solving hands-on challenges awards XP and unlocks achievement badges!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Every time you learn a concept or build a circuit, your engineer level increases!

quickCheck.question: Can you re-visit past lessons to review concepts after completing them?
options: Yes, all completed lessons remain unlocked in your Learn Lab library
quickCheck.explanation: You can re-open any unlocked lesson at any time to refresh your memory or try experiments again!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Great engineers look back at notes and diagrams often. Lessons stay available in your library.

steps.title: Leveling Up
steps.markdownContent:
Collect enough XP, and your overall **Level** will increase.

Leveling up proves you're becoming a more advanced robotics engineer. You'll need high levels to unlock the hardest projects later on.

steps.title: Badges of Honor
steps.markdownContent:
You can also earn **Badges** for special achievements, like getting a perfect score on a safety quiz, or completing all the challenges in a tier.

Check your profile to see all the badges you've earned.

steps.title: Saved Progress
steps.markdownContent:
Monster Lab automatically saves your progress.

If you leave a lesson halfway through, you can come back later and pick up right where you left off.

*Note: You only earn XP for completing a lesson the first time. Re-doing a lesson is great for review, but won't double your XP!*

steps.title: XP Rules
steps.markdownContent: Let's make sure you understand the XP rules.

questions.question: Can you earn XP for completing the same lesson twice?
questions.explanation: You only earn the XP reward the first time you complete a lesson.

questions.question: What happens when you collect enough XP?
questions.explanation: Accumulating XP increases your Level, showing your growth as an engineer.

questions.question: How do you earn Badges?
options: By completing special achievements, like perfect quizzes
questions.explanation: Badges are unlocked by completing specific achievements in the app.
